Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of
right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of
injury is consistent with the force and direction of the impact, and the presenting
symptoms align well with that mechanism. Over the course of 23 visits, the patient
received conservative management including physical therapy, activity modification,
and anti-inflammatory medication. Care progressed along a typical recovery pathway,
with visit frequency decreasing as pain and mobility improved. Imaging and clinical
examination findings clearly confirm the knee injury sustained in the collision. No
prior injury or treatment involving the same body region is known from the patient's
history or available records. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced
charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. At discharge, the
patient was improvnig and was advised to continue a home exercise program and return
for follow-up if symptoms recurred.
